verdict.rationale: Sill is a free, open-source app that streams a Mac window or desktop to an iPhone or iPad for touch, keyboard and Pencil control. It has no concept of user-defined automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of product. Evidence about Sill's own release channels (nightly builds, Homebrew upgrades, update checks) concerns app versions, not user automations, and is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
